The '''dwarf bantha''' or '''miniature bantha''' was a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] which originated on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was much smaller and more skittish than the [[Bantha/Legends|common bantha]]. The dwarf bantha lived in the canyons and cliffs of the outer [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] on Tatooine. The dwarf bantha was less furry than its larger and more well known cousin, the common bantha.<ref name="Wildlife" />

[[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] and [[Pookie Baobab]] had a pet dwarf bantha called [[Nuke]].
